market_view: Calm VIX (16) but bonds had their worst month in years, with the 10-year at a new high near 5.26% and the dollar firm; core PCE came in softer than expected. Oil is easing on US-Iran hopes while Middle East exports recover.

oil_gas.catalyst: none: 'Oil prices settle down 2.5% on signs Middle East exports recovering' (Reuters) is a bearish driver move already in the price
oil_gas.reasoning: Crude is sliding on diplomacy and recovering exports, and XOM is near its highs. No new supply shock and no talks collapse. A driver move that already happened is not a long reason.

gold_miners.catalyst: none: the NEM free-cash-flow stories and the 2027 gold forecast are old news and long-dated
gold_miners.reasoning: Gold is below its 200-day average and the 10-year yield is at a high with a firm dollar. The jobs report adds variance, not direction. No unpriced catalyst.

chips.catalyst: none that is unpriced: 'Micron beats on earnings and issues strong guidance as data center revenue jumps 11-fold' (CNBC) is a read-through to AI demand, but it concerns MU, not NVDA, and will be priced at the open
chips.reasoning: Semis are up 9% in 20 days. The Micron beat is sector-positive but is a same-day event, likely priced by the time of trade. NVDA has no named catalyst of its own. DeepSeek/Huawei headline is a small negative.

pharma.catalyst: none: Lilly mid-stage EloraTZP data (CNBC) and orforglipron safety data are same-day news, offset by 'US Cements Most-Favored-Nation Drug Price Model for Medicare' (Bloomberg Law)
pharma.reasoning: Good trial data are priced on release, and the MFN Medicare pricing model is a policy overhang. The headlines roughly offset. No one-sided unpriced setup for LLY.

copper_uranium.catalyst: none: 'Supply Pressures Emerge; Copper Prices Set to Trend Upward Amid Volatility' (Sunsirs) is a low-quality, vague forecast
copper_uranium.reasoning: Copper and FCX are drifting lower (FCX -4.8% in 5 days) with a strong dollar and high yields. The BHP halt is not followed by any FCX-specific news. The uranium items concern CCJ, not the FCX leader.

would_change_my_mind: A collapse of US-Iran talks or a new supply shock (oil), an NVDA-specific guidance or export event (chips), an FCX-specific outage or China demand surge (copper), or a sharp fall in yields with gold back above its 200-day average (gold).

handoff.what_changed: Oil fell further on signs Middle East exports are recovering (WTI about 89). The 10-year yield hit a new high near 5.26% after bonds had their worst month in years, and gold is near 4,180. Micron beat and guided strongly, a sector read-through for chips, and Lilly posted positive obesity data against a Medicare MFN pricing overhang.

oil_gas.why: Crude is falling on diplomacy and recovering exports, with no new supply shock.

gold_miners.why: Gold is below its 200-day average with yields at a high and no unpriced catalyst.

chips.why: The Micron beat is a priced sector read-through and there is no NVDA-specific catalyst.

pharma.why: Lilly trial data are priced on release and the MFN drug-pricing policy offsets them.

copper_uranium.why: Copper is soft with a strong dollar and there is no FCX-specific news.

handoff.next_job: Next decision day: read this note and the new record; all five families are flat, so stay flat unless a named, unpriced catalyst appears (oil: failed talks or a supply shock; copper: a long BHP outage or FCX-specific news; chips: an NVDA-specific event); watch yields, the Fed and the jobs report.
